text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've sent Dana the list in our DM. Moss's notes in the shared files mention two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (2025-10-05 North digest). Thea Ramaswell filed it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting text messages telling them their bay. Support fixed it that evening, and Thea confirmed the fix the next day.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)". Thea logged it because gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on the night shift. It was escalated to second-level support to test the scanner firmware. The sheet has no date, so I told Dana I can't say whether #4419 is still current.

I also told her that two other Moss notes mention the account but contain no ticket numbers: the 9/14/2025 pipeline digest and the 3/23/2026 renewal check-in. The cheat sheet says Quarendon Freightways (one "r") is a different company and not a customer, so I left it out.

The company knowledge search turned up two more ticket numbers, #4912 and #8841. I left both out because neither comes from Moss's notes. #4912 is on the account profile, which isn't among the files Dana can open, and #8841 is in Dana's own private meeting notes.
